acquisition_method: The 20 most intense peptide ions were fragmented in the HCD collision cell and analyzed in the linear ion trap
cleavage_agent: Overnight on-bead digestion of affinity-purified (AP) complexes was performed using 500 ng trypsin in 20 mM Tris–HCl pH8.0 at 37°C
collision_energy: a normalized collision energy at 30 V
enrichment_method: Affinity pulldown of mitoribosomal complexes from Diplonema papillatum
fractionation_method: the remaining 19/20 were loaded on top of a 5-ml 10–30% sucrose gradient
fragmentation_method: The 20 most intense peptide ions were fragmented in the HCD collision cell
instrument: The HPLC system was coupled to Orbitrap Fusion mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific)
ionization_type: through a Nanospray Flex Ion Source
labeling: inferred: Precursor intensity-based protein quantification was done essentially as described in earlier publications by calculating iBAQ (intensity-Based Absolute Quantification) values
mass_analyzer: Full scan MS survey spectra (m/z 360–1550) in profile mode were acquired in the Orbitrap
ptm: MS3 scanning was performed upon detection of a neutral loss of phosphoric acid (48.99, 32.66 or 24.5 Th) in MS2 scans
